weeks.title: Q1: W1 IPC Gr5 Eureka Math 26-27

days.lo: I am learning to use place value patterns to understand the thousandths place.
sc: I can divide single units by 10 to build the place value chart to introduce thousandths.
I can multiply copies of one unit by 10, 100, and 1,000.
I can divide copies of one unit by 10, 100, and 1,000.
I can multiply mixed units by 10, 100, and 1,000.

days.lo: I am learning to use place value understanding to reason abstractly about values of digits in decimal fractions.
sc: I can describe a pattern for multiplying decimal fractions by 10, 100, or 1,000
I can describe a pattern for dividing decimal fractions by 10, 100, and 1,000
I can visualize a place place chart to multiply and divide decimal fractions by 10,  100, and 1,000

days.lo: I am learning to use place value understanding to convert metric units.
sc: I can rename or convert large units as smaller units using multiplication equations.
I can rename millimeters and centimeters as meters using division equations.
I can convert from both large units to smaller units and small to larger units.

days.lo: I am learning to name decimal fractions in expanded notation, unit form, and word form.
sc: I can represent decimal fractions in expanded notation.
I can represent decimal fractions in standard form.
I can represent decimal fractions in unit form.
I can represent decimal fractions in word form.

weeks.title: Q1: W2 IPC Gr5 Eureka Math 26-27

days.lo: I am learning to compare decimal fractions to the thousandths using like units, and express comparisons with >, <, =.
sc: I can compare whole numbers using a place value chart.
I can compare decimal fractions to the thousandths using a place value chart.
I can order decimal fractions to the thousandths using a place value chart.

days.lo: I am learning to round a given decimal to any place.
sc: I can decompose numbers using multiple units to round to the nearest ten and nearest hundred.
I can decompose numbers to round to the nearest whole and nearest tenth.
I can decompose to round numbers to the nearest ten, one, tenth, and hundredths.
days.note: Combine Lessons 6 & 7: L6 Fluency, Application Problem, Concept Development Problem 1; L7 Concept Development Problems 2 & 3, Problem Set, Debrief/Exit Ticket

weeks.title: Q1: W3 IPC Gr5 Eureka Math 26-27

days.lo: I am learning to add decimals.
sc: I can identify and add like units and write the sum in standard form.
I can add using the standard algorithm.

days.lo: I am learning to subtract decimals.
sc: I can identify and subtract like units and write the difference in standard form.
I can subtract using the standard algorithm.

days.lo: I am learning to multiply a decimal fraction by single-digitwhole numbers.
sc: I can multiply decimal fractions by a single digit whole number using a place value chart and disks.
I can multiply decimal fractions by a single digit whole number using partial products.
I can multiply decimal fractions by a single digit whole number using an area model.

days.lo: I am learning to Multiply a decimal fraction and estimate to confirm the placement of the decimal.
sc: I can multiply decimal fractions by a single digit whole number and use the units to help place the decimal.
I can multiply decimal fractions by a single digit whole number and estimate to confirm the placement of the decimal.

days.lo: I am learning to divide decimals by single-digit whole numbers using hundredth grid area models.
sc: I divide decimals using unit form.
I can strategically decompose the decimal and divide.
I can use hundredth grid area models to divide decimals.

weeks.title: Q1: W4 IPC Gr5 Eureka Math 26-27

days.lo: I am learning to divide decimals by single-digit whole numbers
sc: I divide decimals using unit form.
I can strategically decompose the decimal and divide.
I can use basic facts to divide decimals.

days.lo: I am learning to divide decimals using place value understanding, including remainders in the smallest unit.
sc: I can use place value disks to represent division of decimals
I can relate division with place value disks to the standard algorithm.

days.lo: I am learning to divide decimals using place value understanding, including remainders in the smallest unit.
sc: I can use place value disks to represent division of decimals
I can relate division with place value disks to the standard algorithm.
days.note: Lesson 14 continued; could be a potential Flex/ Re-teach day, if finished with lesson 14

days.lo: I am learning to solve word problems using decimal operations.
sc: I can model the problem.
I can calculate to solve and write a statement.
I can assess the solution.

weeks.title: Q1: W5 IPC Gr5 Eureka Math 26-27

days.lo: I am learning to find factor pairs and define prime and composite.
sc: I can identify the factors and the product represented in an array.
I can identify factors to define prime and composite numbers
I can identify factors of numbers and determine if they are prime or composite.

days.lo: I am learning to test for factors of larger numbers.
sc: I can use division to find factors of larger numbers.
I can use the associative property to find additional factors of larger numbers.
I can use division or the associative property to find factors of larger numbers.

days.lo: I am learning to determine if a whole number is a multiple of another number.
sc: I can determine the meaning of the word multiple.
I can determine if one number is a multiple of another number, and list multiples of given numbers.
I can use the associative property to see that any multiple of 6 is also a multiple of 3 and 2.

days.lo: I am learning the properties of prime and composite numbers to 100.
sc: I can define and identify prime and composite numbers to 100.
I can describe the properties of prime and composite numbers to 100.
I can use multiples to determine prime and composite numbers.

weeks.title: Q1: W6 IPC Gr5 Eureka Math 26-27

days.lo: I am learning to multiply multi-digit whole numbers and multiples of 10.
sc: I can use my knowledge of place value units and basic facts to multiply multi-digit whole numbers and multiples of 10.
I can apply the distributive property to multiply multi-digit whole numbers and multiples of 10.
I can apply the associative property to multiply multi-digit whole numbers and multiples of 10.

days.lo: I am learning to estimate multi-digit products.
sc: I can estimate multi-digit products by rounding factors to a basic fact.
I can estimate multi-digit products by using place value knowledge and rounding.
I can reason if the estimate will be higher or lower than the actual amount.

days.lo: I am learning to write and interpret numerical expressions.
sc: I can rewrite math statements from word form to numerical expressions and represent them with diagrams.
I can rewrite numerical expressions in word form.
I can compare expressions in word form and numerical form.

days.lo: I am learning to describe the meaning of parentheses in a numeric expression and evaluate it.
sc: I can match a story problem to both a strip diagram and a numeric expression.
II can identify which part of a numeric expression should be evaluated first based on grouping symbols.
I can evaluate numerical expressions containing parentheses to find the correct answer.

days.lo: I am learning to describe the meaning of brackets and find the value of numeric expressions with up to two levels of grouping.
sc: I can describe the meaning of brackets.
I can find the value of numeric expressions with up to two levels of grouping.

weeks.title: Q1: W7 IPC Gr5 Eureka Math 26-27

days.lo: I am learning to convert numerical expressions into unit form.
sc: I can designate the unit and relate the unit to the expression.
I can use the commutative property when designating units.
I can draw a diagram to represent expressions in unit form
I can use place value understanding to decompose factors and solve for products mentally.
I can solve for products using the unit form strategy to support mental math.

days.lo: I am learning to connect visual models and the distributive property to partial products of the standard algorithm without renaming.
sc: I can represent units using first the strip diagram and then the area model.
I can solve for products of two-digit and two-digit numbers using the area model and the standard algorithm.
I can solve for products of two-digit and three-digit numbers.

days.lo: I am learning to connect area models and the distributive property to partial products of the standard algorithm with renaming.
sc: I can connect area models with the standard algorithm for multiplication.
I can solve for products using the standard algorithm.

days.lo: I am learning to fluently multiply multi-digit whole numbers using the standard algorithm to solve multi-step word problems.
sc: I can solve multiplication multi-digit word problems using the standard algorithm.

weeks.title: Q1: W8 IPC Gr5 Eureka Math 26-27

days.lo: I am learning to multiply decimal fractions with tenths by multi-digit wholenumbers using place value understanding to record partial products.
sc: I can estimate the product
I can multiply the decimal factor with tens and multiply as if both factors are whole numbers.
I can divide the product by tens to find the original answer when a factor was a decimal.

days.lo: I am learning to multiply decimal fractions by multi-digit whole numbersthrough conversion to a whole number problem and reasoning about the placement of the decimal.
sc: I estimate the product.
I can solve, using the standard algorithm.
I can explain my thinking when placing the decimal in the product.

days.lo: I am learning to reason about the product of a whole number and a decimal with hundredths using place value understanding and estimation.
sc: I estimate the product.
I can solve, using the standard algorithm.
I can represent the product using an area model.

days.lo: I am learning to represent the product of decimals with tenths using hundredths grid area models.
sc: I can represent the product of decimals with tenths.
I can use hundredths grid area models to represent the product of decimals.

days.lo: I am learning to reason about the product of decimals with tenths using area models.
sc: I can reason about the product of decimals with tenths.
I can use area models to determine the product of decimals with tenths.

weeks.title: Q1: W9 IPC Gr5 Eureka Math 26-27

days.lo: I am learning to use whole number multiplication to express equivalent measurements.
sc: I can rename units using equivalency statements.
I can use equivalency statements to determine equivalent measurements
